mentions.name: Hacker Residency
mentions.description: A month-long residency program for indie hackers in Da Nang, Vietnam. Ten indie developers from around the world are invited to live and build together for a month at a villa, free of charge, with sponsorship from companies like OpenRouter, Cognition, n8n, and CodeRabbit. The first batch is currently underway.
mentions.source_excerpt:
hosting a month-long residency for indie hackers in Da Nang, Vietnam!

we invited 10 of the best indie devs from around the world to live & build alongside us for a month at a beautiful villa. for free. (we have sponsors like OpenRouter, Cognition, n8n, and CodeRabbit!)
